name: IndiGamer Esports
description: Level up your game with IndiGamer Esports.
story: IndiGamer Esports has rapidly risen to become a leading force in the Indian gaming scene, sponsoring various esports teams and tournaments. They see motorsport as the next frontier for reaching a wider audience of tech-savvy enthusiasts. They seek a partnership that can amplify their brand's message of skill, precision, and high performance on a global stage, particularly in markets with a strong gaming presence.
